input.summary: Make PB's at-will exit genuinely available (90 days' notice, no $60M/pre-approval gate) with the exit payment reduced to 150% of Development Costs, and require 90 days' prior notice for SFJ's sole-discretion terminations.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook requires a workable customer convenience exit and no vendor walk-away on short notice; as drafted PB can only exit after SFJ has spent $60 million and only by paying 300% of Development Costs, while SFJ may terminate in its sole discretion with no notice period. We have moved PB's at-will right to 90 days' notice without the spend gate, aligned the exit payment with the 150% multiple SFJ already uses in Sections 14.2.6 and 14.2.8.1, and required 90 days' prior written notice for SFJ's discretionary terminations.

ops.oldText: PB may terminate this Agreement at any time after SFJ has paid or incurred a total of $60 million of Development Costs and prior to the date of receipt of the first Regulatory Approval upon [***] prior written notice to SFJ.
ops.newText: PB may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to SFJ.

ops.oldText: SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time following a Change of Control of PB that occurs prior to the date of payment by PB of the final Approval Payment.
ops.newText: SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety upon not less than ninety (90) days' prior written notice to PB at any time following a Change of Control of PB that occurs prior to the date of payment by PB of the final Approval Payment.

ops.oldText: SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time prior to the date of receipt of the first Regulatory Approval
ops.newText: SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety upon not less than ninety (90) days' prior written notice to PB at any time prior to the date of receipt of the first Regulatory Approval
